order: block-01 baseline/candidate, block-02 baseline/candidate, block-03 baseline/candidate
primary: Final-epoch average class5/6 VALID recall candidate minus baseline
secondary: all ten class recalls and harms
support: six valid full-fidelity runs; three paired initializations and train orders; original code and data identities; verified baseline
acceptance: lower paired t95 df2 bound >0 AND nonzero sample SD, conditional direction only pending PI quality review
contradiction: upper paired t95 df2 bound <=0 AND nonzero sample SD, conditional direction refuted pending PI
insufficiency: interval includes zero or zero sample SD; failed/missing/uncertain pair never completes confirmation
adequacy: normal-seed approximation cannot be established with n=3; no known robustness; explicit independent PI quality review mandatory
margin_scope: directional positive effect only, not replication of .6897 magnitude or practical equivalence
multiple_comparisons: one primary; all ten harms descriptive; no secondary confirmatory claims
operator_approval: new protected r18b4-independent-evaluator environment, new human-authenticated digest; not a signature
training_delta: only trusted seed-domain and result-role metadata; original candidate and trainer loop exact
